nc.description: A white sphere is held between two curved, grey panels mounted on a horizontal rod that terminates in faceted blocks.
An abstract 3D rendering depicts a mechanical assembly with looped tracks and faceted rollers appearing to dispense a sequence of floating white discs.
A white rubber band is stretched between a small peg and the faceted hub of a white lever handle mounted on a grey rectangular base.
A grey mechanical assembly consisting of a handle, a support block, a nut, and a coiled spring is positioned above a small rectangular tray.
A collection of gray and white geometric shapes is arranged in a symmetrical pattern radiating outward from a central assembled cube on a white surface.

vc.description: A grey mechanical arm with two pincers is holding a segmented cylindrical object that contains a white sphere.
A grey mechanical model depicts an automated assembly line where gears and a belt drive move cylindrical containers while mechanical arms position caps over them.
A grey mechanical device with four suction cups connected by a frame and a central articulated handle is displayed on a white background.
A grey model of a jointed mechanical arm with a flat end is positioned above a bowl.
Various grey and white geometric components are arranged symmetrically around a central, interlocking silver structure on a white background.
